# MDL113 · `unsupported-flag-without-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A line without `=` in a mydumper version that has no pre-processor.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | safe |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | §3.2, generator: loader of v0.19.1-x |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl113-bare-flag-v0.19.1`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl113-bare-flag-v0.19.1.txtar) |

## Why

Starting with v0.19.3-1, mydumper rewrites a valueless option such as `routines` into `routines= 1` before handing the file to GLib. Earlier versions (v0.19.1-x) load the file with GLib directly: `routines` is then neither a key/value pair, a group nor a comment, so GLib rejects the file and mydumper ignores all of it. Write the value explicitly (`routines=1`), which works with every version.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.1-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
host=db
routines
  triggers
```

```text
3:1-3:9 error MDL113[unsupported-flag-without-value] `routines` has no `=`: mydumper v0.19.1-3 hands the file to GLib without rewriting valueless options into `key= 1` (GLib: Key file contains line “routines” which is not a key-value pair, group, or comment)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
  fix (safe): Write the value explicitly (`routines=1`)
4:1-4:11 error MDL113[unsupported-flag-without-value] `triggers` has no `=`: mydumper v0.19.1-3 hands the file to GLib without rewriting valueless options into `key= 1` (GLib: Key file contains line “  triggers” which is not a key-value pair, group, or comment)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
  fix (safe): Write the value explicitly (`triggers=1`)
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
host=db
routines=1
  triggers=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL113: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
